decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's established two-component offer and has stayed on the website for two years, so nothing suggests a shortfall against aspirations, and the firm's slack in a growing industry lets it carry the product.

The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field application on a construction site, which signals satisfactory results close to the core business and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The transfer pump reuses the proven WIWA air motors, so it costs little to keep and fits the established line, and nothing indicates it falls short of aspirations.
The fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the firm's digitalization strategy, so management would keep it while its results mature, using slack from a growing industry.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only recently and sits close to the core offer, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations and keeping it is the satisficing choice.
